results.question: How many artists are in the database?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ArtistCount FROM Artist

results.question: How many tracks are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track

results.question: List all media types.
results.sql:
SELECT MediaTypeId, Name
FROM MediaType

results.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS BrazilCustomerCount
FROM Customer
WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

results.question: What is the longest track's name?
results.sql:
SELECT Name
FROM Track
ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the average track price?
results.sql:
SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Track

results.question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount
FROM Invoice
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

results.question: Which employees have the title 'Sales Support Agent'? Give first and last names.
results.sql:
SELECT FirstName, LastName
FROM Employee
WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

results.question: How many playlists are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS PlaylistCount FROM Playlist

results.question: What is the total of all invoice totals?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalInvoiceAmount FROM Invoice

results.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount
FROM Album a
JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

results.question: Which 5 countries have the most customers?
results.sql:
SELECT Country,
       COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM Customer
GROUP BY Country
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: What are the top 5 customers by total invoice amount? Give their full names.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalAmount
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Which artist has the most albums?
results.sql:
SELECT a.Name, COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount
FROM Album al
JOIN Artist a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What was the total invoice amount per year?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year,
    SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY Year
ORDER BY Year

results.question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

results.question: Which album has the most tracks?
results.sql:
SELECT a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
GROUP BY a.AlbumId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which employee is the support rep for the most customers? Give their full name.
results.sql:
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS FullName
FROM Employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT SupportRepId, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
    FROM Customer
    WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SupportRepId
) c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
ORDER BY c.cust_cnt DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which billing country had the highest total invoice amount?
results.sql:
SELECT BillingCountry,
       SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which artist generated the most revenue from track sales?
results.sql:
SELECT
    ar.Name,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track tr ON il.TrackId = tr.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON tr.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 genres by revenue?
results.sql:
SELECT
    g.Name,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most invoice revenue? Give the agent's full name.
results.sql:
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS FullName
FROM Employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT c.SupportRepId AS RepId,
           SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.SupportRepId
) r ON e.EmployeeId = r.RepId
ORDER BY r.Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnpurchasedTrackCount
FROM Track t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId
)

results.question: What percentage of tracks are longer than 5 minutes? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
SELECT round(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Milliseconds > 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS Percentage
FROM Track

results.question: Which customer spent the most in 2013? Give their full name.
results.sql:
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
WHERE substr(i.InvoiceDate, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which playlist contains the most tracks?
results.sql:
SELECT p.Name,
       COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Playlist p
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Who does Steve Johnson report to? Give the manager's full name.
results.sql:
SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS ManagerFullName
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
WHERE e.FirstName = 'Steve' AND e.LastName = 'Johnson'

results.question: How many distinct customers bought at least one Jazz track?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS JazzCustomerCount
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

results.question: Which month of 2012 had the highest invoice total? Answer with the month number.
results.sql:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS Month
FROM Invoice
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012'
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: By what percentage did total invoice revenue grow from 2009 to 2010? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
WITH rev AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS yr,
           SUM(Total) AS revenue
    FROM Invoice
    WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) IN ('2009','2010')
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (COALESCE((SELECT revenue FROM rev WHERE yr = '2010'),0) -
     COALESCE((SELECT revenue FROM rev WHERE yr = '2009'),0))
    / NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT revenue FROM rev WHERE yr = '2009'),0),0) * 100,
    1) AS growth_percent

results.question: How many employees report to Andrew Adams, directly or indirectly?
results.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE reports AS (
    SELECT EmployeeId
    FROM Employee
    WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.EmployeeId
    FROM Employee e
    JOIN reports r ON e.ReportsTo = r.EmployeeId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ReportCount
FROM reports

results.question: For each year, which billing country had the second-highest invoice total? Give the year and country.
results.sql:
WITH country_year AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year,
           BillingCountry AS country,
           SUM(Total) AS total
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY year, country
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT year,
           country,
           total,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk
    FROM country_year
)
SELECT year, country
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2
ORDER BY year

results.question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM (
    SELECT i.CustomerId
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i.CustomerId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10
) AS customers

results.question: How many artists have tracks in more than one genre?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ArtistCount
FROM (
    SELECT ar.ArtistId
    FROM Track t
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1
) AS sub

results.question: Which calendar month had the highest invoice total across the whole history? Answer as YYYY-MM.
results.sql:
SELECT month
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month,
           SUM(Total) AS month_total
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY month
    ORDER BY month_total DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

results.question: Which genre had the second-highest number of tracks sold to customers billed in the USA?
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name
FROM (
    SELECT t.GenreId, SUM(il.Quantity) AS total
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA'
    GROUP BY t.GenreId
    ORDER BY total DESC
    LIMIT 2
) AS top2
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = top2.GenreId
ORDER BY top2.total ASC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which customers made purchases in every year from 2009 to 2013 and spent more than $45 in total? Give full names.
results.sql:
WITH cust_years AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           substr(i.InvoiceDate,1,4) AS yr
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    WHERE substr(i.InvoiceDate,1,4) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, yr
),
cust_total AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_spent
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
)
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName
FROM Customer c
JOIN cust_years cy ON c.CustomerId = cy.CustomerId
JOIN cust_total ct ON c.CustomerId = ct.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, ct.total_spent
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cy.yr) = 5
   AND MIN(cy.yr) = '2009'
   AND MAX(cy.yr) = '2013'
   AND ct.total_spent > 45

results.question: What percentage of track-sales revenue came from video tracks (media types containing 'video')? Round to one decimal place.
results.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    CASE WHEN total_rev = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE video_rev * 100.0 / total_rev
    END, 1) AS VideoRevenuePct
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_rev,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN lower(mt.Name) LIKE '%video%' 
                THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS video_rev
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
) AS rev

results.question: How many customers made no purchases in 2013?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomersWithNoPurchasesIn2013
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice i
    WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
      AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2013'
)
